text: {"assertions":["WebSocket sessions in realtime/ws/session.ts were dropping frames when two requests raced on the same key.","The root cause of the dropped frames was an N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation.","The fix prefetched the relation in a single query and was implemented in PR #2756 on branch fix/dropped-frames-1.","The dropped frames issue could be reproduced by holding a socket open through a network flap.","The test realtime/ws/session.test.ts was flaky, failing 43 times per 100 runs before the fix.","The flaky test realtime/ws/session.test.ts achieved zero failures after the prefetch fix."]}
